BiblicalUsage: Banah means to build, and it runs from the first building in Scripture, when God builds a woman from Adam's rib. It runs on to the tower men built to make a name for themselves, to God's promise that David's son would build a house for His name, and to the proverb that a wise woman builds her house while the foolish tears hers down.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe building is the work God gave us, but the builder decides what the building is for. God builds a woman, men build a tower, and a son builds a temple, and I hold that only the building God orders stands when the testing comes.
RelatedEvents: Creation; The Tower of Babel; Davidic Covenant
